skills.Docker: Consider learning Docker fundamentals and containerizing a sample application.
skills.Kubernetes: Consider learning Kubernetes basics (pods, deployments, services) by deploying a small containerized app to a local cluster such as minikube or kind.
skills.AWS: Explore AWS fundamentals and practice deploying a simple application.
skills.Azure: Explore Azure fundamentals and practice deploying a simple application to Azure App Service.
skills.GCP: Explore Google Cloud fundamentals and practice deploying a simple service to Cloud Run.
skills.Python: Consider building a small Python project (for example a CLI tool or API) to practice core language features.
skills.Java: Consider building a small Java application to practice core language features and the standard library.
skills.JavaScript: Consider building a small JavaScript project to practice the language, the DOM and asynchronous programming.
skills.TypeScript: Consider converting a small JavaScript project to TypeScript to practice static typing.
skills.React: Consider building a small React application to practice components, state and hooks.
skills.SQL: Consider practicing SQL queries (joins, aggregations, indexes) against a sample database.
skills.PostgreSQL: Consider setting up PostgreSQL locally and designing a small relational schema with queries and indexes.
skills.FastAPI: Consider building a small REST API with FastAPI to practice routing, validation and dependency injection.
skills.Django: Consider following the official Django tutorial and building a small CRUD application.
skills.Git: Consider practicing Git workflows (branching, pull requests, rebasing) on a personal project.
skills.CI/CD: Consider setting up a CI pipeline (for example GitHub Actions) that runs tests and builds a sample project.
skills.Terraform: Consider learning Terraform basics by provisioning a small cloud resource as code.
skills.REST APIs: Consider designing and documenting a small REST API, covering resource modeling, status codes and error handling.
skills.TensorFlow: Consider working through an introductory TensorFlow tutorial and training a small model.
skills.PyTorch: Consider working through an introductory PyTorch tutorial and training a small model.
skills.Machine Learning: Consider completing an end-to-end machine learning project on a public dataset, including evaluation.
skills.Pytest: Consider adding Pytest tests (fixtures, parametrization) to an existing Python project.
skills.Kafka: Consider learning Kafka basics by building a small producer and consumer locally.
